_readme: Rates for the rising main of a pumping station (DI pipe), for the approximate cost of zoning options. User decision 12-Oct-2026: SOR rates from 'sor springfield.xlsx' (SCHEDULE OF RATES FOR YEAR 2025-26); the other rates as before (DI supply from Rate_2025-26.pdf M.193, specials and thrust blocks from the Elmwood DPR - all as in the original scripts\sor_rates.json). Rates exclude GST / cess / contingency, as the other cost items.

pipe_supply_di_k7._source: Rate_2025-26.pdf (UPJN SE Construction Circle Westbrook, office memo 22-08-2025), M.193 DI K-7 p9-10, M.194 HDPE IS 4984:2016 PN-6 p10. Used in Elmwood DPR Springfield (DS!I9:I20).
pipe_supply_di_k7.class: K-7 (IS 8329) - the only DI class with a rate here; a rising main is often K-9 (not available - K-7 used, slightly low)

laying_di._source: sor springfield.xlsx (SOR 2025-26) items 2197-2210: carting, laying and testing of C.I. S&S class 'LA' tyton joint pipes & specials

excavation._source: sor springfield.xlsx (SOR 2025-26) item 2001 - pipe line in ordinary soil incl. refilling
excavation.trench: L x (D + 0.6) x (D + 1.0), D in m - Elmwood DPR, RC!E5 (as boq.py)

specials_fraction._source: Elmwood DPR Springfield, DS!K21:K22 (specials @5% of HDPE pipe cost, @10% of DI pipe cost).

thrust_block._source: Elmwood DPR Springfield DS!106-122: one block per 200 m of DI main (ROUNDUP(L/200)); RCC 1:1.5:3 item 1025 @ 11260.02/cum; MS reinforcement item 1151 @ 106.0084/kg (SOR 2025-26). Volume and steel per block: DPR sheets 'Thrust 200' ... 'Thrust 400'.

max_velocity_mps.note: smallest DI size with velocity at peak flow not above this; above the largest size with a supply rate (600 mm) parallel mains are taken

route_factor.note: rising main length = straight distance to the STP x this (along the roads)

delivery_head_m.note: delivery above GL at the STP inlet

check.note: Lakeside zone DPR (AMRUT 2.0, appraisal 29-08-2025, the user's 'this file to imrove ips rates.pdf'): rising main 450 & 300 mm, 3400 m = Rs 422.53 lakh = Rs 12,427 per m all-in - compare with the rate built here
